messages.text:
I’m sorry for the delay. Our records don’t yet show your duvet set as received back, so no refund has been issued. Items must be recorded as received before they can be refunded (refund-policy/v2/return).

Since you’ve already sent it, a staff member will take over to check the return (refund-policy/v2/return).
